quirks.name: Beloved lecturer
quirks.line: Students would follow them into a fire. Publishes nothing.

quirks.name: Grant magnet
quirks.line: Writes proposals in their sleep, and occasionally in lectures.

quirks.name: Never on campus Fridays
quirks.line: Or, it is beginning to appear, Thursdays.

quirks.name: Harsh grader
quirks.line: The median is a C, and the median is proud of it.

quirks.name: Came for the view
quirks.line: Will work for the view. Asks very little else.

quirks.name: A name
quirks.line: People have heard of them. The name costs extra.

quirks.name: Office hours that happen
quirks.line: Holds office hours at the posted time, in the posted room. Legendary.

quirks.name: Committee creature
quirks.line: Sits on every committee, chairs three, and calls this service.

quirks.name: Bench hermit
quirks.line: Lives in the lab. Students report a lamp under the door.

quirks.name: Teaches to the back row
quirks.line: Loudly, with props. The props have a budget line.

quirks.name: One book
quirks.line: Twenty years, one book. A terrific book, by every account but the dean's.

quirks.name: The easy A
quirks.line: The course is always full, everyone leaves happy, and nobody knows anything.

quirks.name: Remembers every advisee
quirks.line: Their name, their thesis, and which of the two they should have chosen.

quirks.name: Serial sabbatical
quirks.line: Applied for a sabbatical the week they arrived. Will apply again.

quirks.name: The feud
quirks.line: Has a feud with a rival department that predates the rival department.

readings.headcount: Everyone on the faculty roster, hired or not yet assigned to a program.
readings.payroll: Every hire's salary for a year; it is paid week by week whether they teach or not.
readings.adminShare: Administration's share of all payroll: it only ever creeps up.
readings.teaching: Program quality averaged over the open programs: faculty skill, damped by understaffing, lifted by tier, worn by the hall.
readings.market: Candidates listed this summer; the list closes when the budget is approved.
readings.teachingSkill: How well they teach, 0 to 100, with their quirk counted.
readings.researchSkill: How well they publish, 0 to 100, with their quirk counted.
readings.salary: What they cost a year, on the faculty payroll from the week they are hired.
readings.programQuality: This program's quality: its faculty's teaching, damped by understaffing, lifted by tier, worn by the hall.
readings.staffing: Hires assigned against the hires this tier needs; below the need, quality is damped.

lines.noFaculty: No one is on the faculty yet. The market opens at Budget & Hiring, in the summer.
lines.marketClosed: The market is closed until Budget & Hiring.
lines.marketOpen: The market is open: {count} candidates are listed, and every one of them is very excited about the opportunity.
lines.marketEmpty: Every candidate is hired. The rest of the summer is quiet.
lines.noProgramsForSchool: No open program in {school}; they can be assigned when one opens.
lines.unfoundedField: Their field, {school}, is not founded here.
lines.unassignedNote: {count} on the roster are not teaching anything.
